scripts.convert:unix: for file in cheatsheets/*.md; do node scripts/markdown-pdf/convert.js "$file" pdf --css=scripts/markdown-pdf/custom.css --outdir=assets/pdfs; node scripts/markdown-pdf/convert.js "$file" html --css=scripts/markdown-pdf/custom.css --outdir=assets/html; done
scripts.convert:win: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem -Path cheatsheets -Filter *.md | ForEach-Object { node scripts/markdown-pdf/convert.js $_.FullName pdf --css=scripts/markdown-pdf/custom.css --outdir=assets/pdfs ; node scripts/markdown-pdf/convert.js $_.FullName html --css=scripts/markdown-pdf/custom.css --outdir=assets/html }"
scripts.build:base: npm run clean:assets && npm run copy:md
scripts.dev:unix: npm run build:base && npm run convert:unix && npm run dev:incremental
scripts.dev:win: npm run build:base && npm run convert:win && npm run dev:incremental
scripts.dev:incremental: concurrently -k -n JEKYLL,CONVERT 'npm run serve' 'npm run watch:md'
scripts.start: echo 'ERRO: Use npm run start:unix ou npm run start:win'
